title: Two dimensional Villain model in the BKT phase
summary: We establish sharp two-point function asymptotics for the two dimensional Villain model at sufficiently low temperatures, confirming a central prediction in the Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless theory. We characterise the power law exponent through the renormalisation group flow of a marginal line defect observable in the dual high-temperature Discrete Gaussian model.
